controls.control: Batas ukuran body request default 1 MiB → 413 (dapat dikonfigurasi `maxBodyBytes`)
Timeout handler/loader default 10s → 503 + `request.signal` abort (dapat dikonfigurasi `timeoutMs`)
Batas request bersamaan default 100 → 503 + `Retry-After` (load shedding)
Security headers default (CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy)
CSP dengan nonce per request — inline script diizinkan tanpa `unsafe-inline`
Proteksi CSRF double-submit cookie + validasi origin (Web Crypto, timing-safe)
Guard SSRF `guardedFetch`: validasi host/IP, blokir rentang privat, cek per-hop redirect
Rate limit per klien (token bucket) → 429 + `Retry-After`; identitas dari adapter, `trustProxy` opt-in
Validasi schema runtime di trust boundary (Standard Schema: query/body/params)
Batas ukuran dokumen SSR (mencegah output tak terkendali)
Kebijakan supply chain: quarantine 24 jam, `pnpm audit` di CI, Dependabot mingguan, justifikasi dependency
Runtime Rust: permission deny-all (fs/env/net) hanya via `--allow-*`; `revoke()` runtime
Kuota runtime: heap V8, watchdog timeout, CPU per-thread, RSS proses
gaps: Heap hanya heap V8 — ArrayBuffer besar tidak dihitung; alokasi raksasa tunggal masih bisa OOM fatal
